material.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
material.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 13 to Aug 17 (+36%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−3.4% to −8.5%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the May 15 low in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Jun 25, 2025 to Feb 11 and a pullback of 0.51 of them to the Mar 13 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−15%); a close over the wave-1 high (+15%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

against.text: Price is below its falling 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is below the 200-day.
against.learn: Both averages falling with price under them: the long trend points down.

against.head: The trigger failed before
against.text: It closed above this line 4 times since Oct 1 and gave it back each time.
against.learn: A line price closed above and then gave back has failed once already; the next break has to hold to count.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: Falling swing highs and lows are the steps of a downtrend.

material.head: A buy signal in a broken trend
material.text: Such signals lagged the market in the desk's study.

material.head: Buyers stepping in earlier (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a higher low in price (the week of Oct 5) against a lower low in momentum (7 of 7 gauges): hidden bullish divergence.
material.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

material.head: Quiet selling on the dip
material.text: Volume on the current pullback runs 37% below its 50-day average: profit-taking, not an exit.
material.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.

material.head: Pullback in an uptrend

material.head: −7.5% from its 52-week high
material.text: The 52-week low is 60% under the price.
material.learn: The highest price of the past year; above it, no one who bought in the last year is waiting to sell at breakeven.

material.head: Stretched below its 50-day
material.text: 4.5 ATR under the 50-day average (−3.1% away), among its widest gaps of the year.
material.learn: How far price sits from its 50-day average in ATR; far stretches tend to pause or snap back.
